name: retrieval-golden-v1
purpose: Evaluate retrieval relevance while tuning chunking and vector-search settings.

labeling.matching_rule: A retrieved chunk is relevant when course and source_file match and its section matches after whitespace is removed and case is folded. This handles OCR whitespace artifacts while labels omit chunk_id and remain stable when the corpus is re-chunked.
labeling.scope: Retrieval relevance only; this dataset does not evaluate generated answer quality.
